title: Char and Bool variables
description:
There are 2 more common data types in C#, Bool, and Char. Bool stands for Boolean, and can _only ever be one of 2 values_, **true** or **false**. Char is a _single_ charecter wrapped in **single quotes**.
Chronoshard needs a way to keep track of the users stage and if the yare dead! Make the variable stage and set it to the value A, and make a variable isDead and set it to the value false
hint: Remember, chars must be wraped in _SINGLE_ quotes. **''**
